search.authentication_safety: Credential material and authorization headers were not inspected, printed, copied, hashed, or persisted.

target.identity_rule: Only exact whole-file SHA-256 equality establishes identity.

model_artifacts.archive_member_handling: All ZIP central directories were inspected. No H5, Keras, or SavedModel member existed, so no model member required extraction. Archive bytes were hashed as downloaded.

non_model_artifacts.note: All 165 notebook sources were downloaded and hashed; candidate notebook declarations are not exact-model provenance without an exact artifact hash.

recommendation: Stop provenance searching permanently and train a new reproducible UCF hybrid model with a pinned preprocessing manifest, persisted generator class_indices, exact source revision, and model-byte hash.
limitations: Kaggle kernels files listed three H5 files and two SavedModel exports that the authenticated current-session kernels output endpoint did not return; repeated filtered and unfiltered downloads produced only logs.

Numeric notebook versions are not exposed by Kaggle CLI 2.2.4 pull/list metadata for most current outputs; those artifacts are located as the latest output at the authenticated search timestamp. The saba2114 candidate is version 2 from prior API evidence and was also recovered through the version-2 output locator.
A transient HTTP 429 burst occurred during initial pulls; every one of the 165 source pulls and 165 output inventories later succeeded under throttled retries.
Architecture, shape, timestamps, behavior, metrics, and preprocessing similarity were not used as identity evidence.
